<div class="card-body">
'''Warrior's Courage''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦士の勇気</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">位置カードでの戦闘で、任意の戦士が単独で防衛している場合、戦闘運命数を１回余分に引ける。または、位置カードでの戦闘で、レイアが単独で防衛している場合、戦闘運命数を２回余分に引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-119o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍兵士はみな、反乱同盟軍の自由の理想を心から信じ、勇敢に戦う。勇猛で機転の利く反乱軍は、しばしば帝国軍の軍勢を打ち負かしている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Warrior's Courage.

'''Card text:''' In a battle at a site, if any warrior is defending alone, you may draw one extra battle destiny. Or, if Leia is defending alone at a site, you may draw two extra battle destinies.

'''Lore:''' Rebel soldiers fight bravely out of a sincere belief in the Alliance's ideal of freedom. Brave and resourceful Rebels often defeat Imperial forces.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Warrior's Courage]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
